apps.name: PhotoCraft
apps.summary: Raster image editor: crop, retouch, color and layer work on the visitor's device.
apps.notes: The app's WebAssembly ships gzip-compressed and split into parts, so it survives hosts with a 25 MiB file cap.

apps.name: VectorCraft
apps.summary: Vector graphics editor: paths, shapes, typography and a PDF backend for import and export.
apps.notes: Large single WebAssembly module (about 67 MiB); extra fonts can be dropped into fonts/ next to the app.

apps.name: CADCraft
apps.summary: Computer-aided design and drafting: 2D and 3D drawing, object snaps, layers, dimensions and DXF files.
apps.notes: Upstream is in early development. The desktop JSON control channel is not part of the web build.

apps.name: GridCraft
apps.summary: Spreadsheet: formulas, tables, charts, pivot tables and XLSX workbooks.
apps.notes: Upstream is in alpha. Workbooks are opened and saved through the browser; nothing is stored on a server.

apps.name: DeckCraft
apps.summary: Presentations and slide shows: layouts, shapes, charts, transitions and PPTX files.
apps.notes: Upstream is in alpha, heading for beta. The web build keeps no preferences between visits.

apps.name: PdfCraft
apps.summary: PDF reader and editor: page thumbnails, annotations, text and export.
apps.notes: Pure client side: PDFs are read from the browser file picker and never uploaded.

apps.name: FilmCraft
apps.summary: Non-linear video editor: cut, trim and composite clips, with audio.
apps.notes: Uses an AudioWorklet for audio; video decode falls back to slower paths on browsers without WebCodecs.

apps.name: SoundCraft
apps.summary: Digital audio workstation: multitrack editing, mixer, MIDI, recording and bouncing.
apps.notes: Upstream is pre-alpha. Playback starts on the first click or key press; recording asks for microphone permission.

apps.name: WordCraft
apps.summary: Word processor: ribbon, styles, tables, track changes and DOCX files.
apps.notes: Upstream is in alpha. Documents are opened and saved through the browser; nothing is stored on a server.

catalog.name: FigCraft
catalog.summary: Interface design and prototyping: frames, auto layout, components, variables and prototypes.

catalog.name: LightCraft
catalog.summary: Non-destructive photo library and RAW developer: browse, develop and export RAW images.

catalog.name: EffectCraft
catalog.summary: Motion graphics and compositing: node-style effects, animation and rendering.

catalog.name: DesignCraft
catalog.summary: Page and layout design editor: grids, columns, typography and publishing-ready output.
